summary.text: Chris Ward was first elected to the California State Assembly in 2020 to represent the 78th Assembly District, which includes San Diego and El Cajon. He chairs the Assembly Committee on Arts, Entertainment, Sports, and Tourism and the California Legislative LGBTQ Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Before the Assembly he served on the San Diego City Council, and earlier he was chief of staff to state Senator Marty Block.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Johns Hopkins University and a master's in public policy and urban planning from Harvard University's John F. Kennedy School of Government, and he lives in University Heights.
